The following events took place in '''24 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] began to prepare their galaxy-wide invasion.
*24:3:7&mdash;[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] annotates his copy of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force|The Jedi Path]].<ref>''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'' {{C|real-life book}}</ref>
*The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] tracked [[Wac Bur]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] counterfeiter, to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] from [[Gebbu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>
*59:5&mdash;[[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|executor]] [[Nom Anor]] met the Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Goran Beviin]] in the [[Bar Jaraniz]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to hire him to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Tholote B'Leph]], an opposition [[Politics/Legends|politician]] on [[Ter Abbes]].<ref name="Boba Fett: A Practical Man">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', though the e-book's related chapter says ''"fifth month, 24 A. B. Y."'', it is known that the in-universe calendar was not changed from the older dating system.</ref>
*A few days before the election in 59:6&mdash;B'Leph was killed, causing a civil war on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="APM" />
*The Yuuzhan Vong [[Yomin Carr]] infiltrated the [[Extragalactic Society|ExGal Society]] in preparation for the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|takeover]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
*[[Diversity Alliance]] crisis.
*The Diversity Alliance was [[Battle of the Emperor's Plague Storehouse|destroyed]], and the [[Cooperative Council of Independent Planetary Governments]] was formed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
*The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] was [[Battle of Kessel (Black Sun Insurgency)|destroyed]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].
*[[Tsavong Lah]] was [[Escalation|escalated]] to [[Warmaster]].
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] met with the leaders of two groups engaged in a civil war on [[Anobis]] and stopped the fighting.
*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] established a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation in the [[Dubrillion system/Legends|Dubrillion system]].
